narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>It will not always happen, because some figure may have a fitting angle in between.
<bookmark mark='try'/>Suppose a figure with smallest angle ninety degrees also fits after one hundred degrees.
<bookmark mark='back'/>Turn it back by ninety degrees, and it would fit after only ten degrees.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Ten degrees is smaller than the smallest angle, which cannot be, so the bubble is struck.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Find the smallest angle, then keep adding it until you reach a full turn.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A figure has smallest angle of symmetry eighteen degrees. Which angle comes after thirty six degrees?
